#include <xfilter/xfframe.hxx>

 * @brief
 * Floating frame on any page.

 */

{
public:

     * @descr   output range: [start,end], not [start,end).
     */

public:

private:
    sal_Int32 m_nStart;
    sal_Int32 m_nEnd;
    bool m_bAll;
};
